H1.claim: gmp: displacement against and oppLiq in the way each fire on at least 40 % of discovery setups, and trades carrying them are not worse

H2.claim: gmp: trades the volatility gate holds back are not worse than the rest

H3.claim: replica: poor location is the leading wait reason and trades carrying it are not worse than the rest

H4.claim: the evidence margin does not rank trades: its rank correlation with net R is not positive on replica and gmp

H5.claim: the similar-cases vote does not separate better trades from worse on any edge

H6.claim: none of the four judgement gates marks a group of trades with negative net R on any edge with at least 20 gated trades
